# http-semantics

HTTP method/status/resource semantics per RFC 9110 and caching per RFC 9111 - the normative base the REST rules cite.

## Recipes

- `apiforge knowledge show http-semantics`
- `apiforge judge` then filter findings by rules AF-REST-001, AF-REST-002, AF-REST-003, AF-REST-008
